info.title: SimeTown API
info.description: One API for the resident, shop, sponsor and SDP views. Amounts of money are whole sen; 1 SimeTown Point = 1 sen. State-changing requests must carry an Origin header equal to the app origin. Lists use `cursor` and `limit`.

session.name: kita_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by sign-in (named __Host-kita_session over HTTPS).

token.description: CRON_SECRET or SENSOR_INGEST_TOKEN from the environment.

Error.description: The request was refused. `error.code` is stable; `error.message` is safe to show to a person.
